headline_zh: 16/16 (100.0%) 确定性拦截 x402 AVM 超长哈希/EVM 传输误判/SVM 证明篡改/MCP 静默 402、UCP 分单配置失配与 MCP Skills/DPoP/异步审批越权
headline_en: 16/16 (100.0%) Deterministic Defense Across x402 AVM/EVM/SVM/MCP-Sync, UCP Split-Payment Profile/CIMD & MCP Skills/DPoP/Async-Approval

scenarios.title_zh: x402 AVM 32字符 CAIP-2、EVM 验签 RPC 重试、SVM 可读证明与同步 MCP 客户端合规放行
scenarios.title_en: x402 AVM Canonical CAIP-2, EVM Retryable Lookup, SVM Readable Proof & Sync MCP Pass
scenarios.task_zh: 校验 `algorand:wGHE2Pwd...` 32字符引用、EVM `failed_to_verify_signature`、SVM 可读证明协商及同步 MCP 抛错门控
scenarios.task_en: Verify 32-char Algorand CAIP-2, EVM `failed_to_verify_signature`, negotiated SVM readable proof & sync MCP error gate
scenarios.reason: x402 AVM canonical CAIP-2, EVM retryable lookup errors, SVM readable batch proofs, Python MCP sync hooks, and Bazaar input contract verified.

scenarios.title_zh: x402 Algorand 遗留 44 字符全量 Genesis Hash 突破 CAIP-2 32 字符上限阻断
scenarios.title_en: x402 Algorand Legacy 44-Char Genesis Hash Exceeding CAIP-2 32-Char Limit Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截超出 CAIP-2 32 字符上限的旧版 Algorand 完整创世哈希标识 (`PR #3894`)
scenarios.task_en: Block legacy 44-char Algorand genesis-hash network identifier exceeding CAIP-2 32-char limit (`PR #3894`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: Algorand v2 requires canonical 32-char CAIP-2 network identifiers and rejects full 44-char genesis hashes (PR #3894).

scenarios.title_zh: x402 EVM Permit2/EIP-1271 链上查询网络故障误判为签名错误 (`invalid_permit2_signature`) 阻断
scenarios.title_en: x402 EVM Permit2/EIP-1271 RPC Transport Failure Misreported as Bad Signature Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截 `eth_getCode`/`isValidSignature` 传输超时被误报为不可重试的 `invalid_permit2_signature` (`PR #3886`)
scenarios.task_en: Block reporting `eth_getCode`/`isValidSignature` transport failure as non-retryable `invalid_permit2_signature` (`PR #3886`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: EVM Permit2/EIP-3009/EIP-1271 eth_getCode or isValidSignature transport failures must report invalid_*_evm_failed_to_verify_signature (PR #3886).

scenarios.title_zh: x402 SVM 可读批量证明未达成三方支持协商或浏览器钱包改写签名载荷阻断
scenarios.title_en: x402 SVM Readable Batch Proof Unnegotiated or Browser Signer Byte Mutation Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截未获客户端/资源服/Facilitator 共同支持或浏览器插件改写签名原始字节的 SVM 可读证明 (`PR #3905`)
scenarios.task_en: Block SVM `readable` batch proof lacking three-party support or matching signed bytes (`PR #3905`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: Opt-in SVM readable batch proofs require matching client/server/facilitator support and exact signed-bytes verification (PR #3905).

scenarios.title_zh: x402 Python `x402MCPClientSync` 在 `auto_payment=False` 时静默返回未支付 402 结果阻断
scenarios.title_en: x402 Python `x402MCPClientSync` Silently Returning Unpaid 402 Result Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截 `auto_payment=False` 或 `on_payment_requested` 拒付时不抛 `PaymentRequiredError` 而静默返回 402 (`PR #3907`)
scenarios.task_en: Block `x402MCPClientSync` returning unpaid 402 result instead of raising `PaymentRequiredError` (`PR #3907`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: x402MCPClientSync must raise PaymentRequiredError when auto_payment=False or on_payment_requested returns False (PR #3907).

scenarios.title_zh: x402 Bazaar `info.input` 随 `GET` 探测方法污染为 `method: GET` + `bodyType` 畸形结构阻断
scenarios.title_en: x402 Bazaar `info.input` Mutating into `method: GET` + `bodyType` on `GET` Probe Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截将探测请求动词 `GET` 混入带请求体的目标资源声明 (`PR #3906`)
scenarios.task_en: Block Bazaar `info.input` adopting probe method `GET` alongside `bodyType`/`body` (`PR #3906`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: Bazaar info.input must describe the target resource contract rather than coupling GET probe method with bodyType/body (PR #3906).

scenarios.title_zh: UCP 分单支付 Profile 对象字典映射、CIMD 无注册身份绑定与 MCP 信封对齐放行
scenarios.title_en: UCP Split-Payment Profile Map (`#658`), CIMD Identity (`#985`) & MCP Envelope (`#444`) Pass
scenarios.task_zh: 校验 `capabilities` 反向域名键值映射、必填 `schema` URL、CIMD `private_key_jwt` 及 `cart-mcp` 信封一致
scenarios.task_en: Verify reverse-domain `capabilities` object map, required `schema` URL, CIMD `private_key_jwt` & `cart-mcp` alignment
scenarios.reason: UCP split-payment profile object map, registration-agnostic CIMD identity linking, and MCP checkout/order binding verified.

scenarios.title_zh: UCP 分单支付 Profile 将 `capabilities` 序列化为数组而非反向域名对象映射阻断
scenarios.title_en: UCP Split-Payment Profile Serializing `capabilities` as Array Instead of Object Map Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截违反 `ucp.json` 规范将 `capabilities` 写成 JSON 数组的未校验示例 (`PR #658`)
scenarios.task_en: Block profile serializing `capabilities` as a JSON array instead of an object map keyed by reverse-domain name (`PR #658`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: UCP profile capabilities must be an object map keyed by reverse-domain name, not a list (PR #658).

scenarios.title_zh: UCP 分单支付能力条目缺失 `schema` URL 或绑定未发布该扩展的旧版 `2026-01-23` 阻断
scenarios.title_en: UCP Split-Payment Capability Missing `schema` URL or Pinning Legacy `2026-01-23` Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截缺失 `schema` 字段或错误锁定旧版本 `2026-01-23` 的分单支付能力声明 (`PR #658`)
scenarios.task_en: Block split-payment capability omitting `schema` URL or pinning `2026-01-23` (`PR #658`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: dev.ucp.shopping.split_payment capability entry requires schema URL and cannot pin pre-feature version 2026-01-23 (PR #658).

scenarios.title_zh: UCP 身份绑定对 CIMD HTTPS `client_id` 强制预设静态 `client_secret` 阻断
scenarios.title_en: UCP Identity Linking Presuming Static `client_secret` for CIMD HTTPS `client_id` Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截在 IETF Client ID Metadata Documents 免注册流程中仍强制要求 `client_secret` (`PR #985`)
scenarios.task_en: Block presuming `client_secret` when platform authenticates via registration-free CIMD + `private_key_jwt` (`PR #985`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: UCP identity-linking must support registration-free Client ID Metadata Documents with private_key_jwt without presuming client_secret (PR #985).

scenarios.title_zh: UCP MCP Checkout/Order 工具绑定偏离 `cart-mcp` 统一信封模式阻断
scenarios.title_en: UCP MCP Checkout/Order Tool Binding Drifting from `cart-mcp` Envelope Pattern Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截 MCP Checkout 或 Order 绑定与 `cart-mcp` 请求响应结构不一致 (`PR #444`)
scenarios.task_en: Block MCP Checkout/Order binding drifting from the canonical `cart-mcp` envelope pattern (`PR #444`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: UCP MCP checkout and order tool bindings must align with the canonical cart-mcp envelope pattern (PR #444).

scenarios.title_zh: MCP 一等公民 Agent Skills 原语、DPoP 发送方约束与异步工具审批放行
scenarios.title_en: MCP First-Class Agent Skills (`SEP-2076`), DPoP (`SEP-1932`) & Async Approval (`SEP-2848`) Pass
scenarios.task_zh: 校验 `skills/get` 清单 SHA-256、DPoP `ath/htu/jti` 绑定及高风险工具异步 `approved` 门控
scenarios.task_en: Verify `SEP-2076` skill manifest SHA-256, `SEP-1932` DPoP `ath/htu/jti` binding & `SEP-2848` async `approved` gate
scenarios.reason: MCP SEP-2076 Agent Skills primitive, SEP-1932 DPoP sender-constrained tokens, and SEP-2848 async tool approval verified.

scenarios.title_zh: MCP Agent Skill 原语缺失清单哈希或越权调用未声明工具阻断
scenarios.title_en: MCP `SEP-2076` Agent Skill Missing Manifest Digest or Undeclared Tool Escalation Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截未绑定技能清单 SHA-256 摘要或超出技能声明范围调用敏感工具 (`SEP-2076`)
scenarios.task_en: Block MCP skill invocation lacking manifest digest or escalating to undeclared tools (`SEP-2076`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: MCP SEP-2076 Agent Skills primitive requires a verified manifest digest and blocks undeclared tool escalation (#2076).

scenarios.title_zh: MCP DPoP 证明 `ath` 哈希失配或跨端点重放 `jti` 阻断
scenarios.title_en: MCP `SEP-1932` DPoP Proof `ath`/`htu` Mismatch or Replayed `jti` Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截 `DPoP` 证明与访问令牌 `ath`、目标 MCP 端点 `htu` 不一致或重放 `jti` (`SEP-1932`)
scenarios.task_en: Block MCP DPoP proof with mismatched `ath`/`htu` or replayed `jti` (`SEP-1932`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: MCP SEP-1932 DPoP profile requires matching ath, htu, and non-replayed jti (#1932).

scenarios.title_zh: MCP DPoP 证明重放已消费的 `jti` 随机数阻断
scenarios.title_en: MCP `SEP-1932` Replayed `jti` Nonce on DPoP Proof Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截攻击者截获并重放同一 `jti` 的 MCP `DPoP` 证明 (`SEP-1932`)
scenarios.task_en: Block replayed `jti` nonce on an MCP DPoP proof (`SEP-1932`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: MCP SEP-1932 DPoP profile requires matching ath, htu, and non-replayed jti (#1932).

scenarios.title_zh: MCP 异步审批处于 `pending`/`rejected` 时提前执行高影响工具调用阻断
scenarios.title_en: MCP `SEP-2848` Executing Consequential Tool Before Async Approval Grants `approved` Block
scenarios.task_zh: 拦截在异步审批尚未达到 `approved` 状态前执行扣款/写操作工具调用 (`SEP-2848`)
scenarios.task_en: Block executing a consequential tool call while `SEP-2848` async approval is `pending` or `rejected` (`SEP-2848`)
scenarios.action_zh: 确定性阻断 (Send to a human / Block)
scenarios.reason: MCP SEP-2848 consequential tool execution must wait for asynchronous approval status=='approved' (#2848).
